card.name: Clinical in cross-reference to pharmacology
card.fires_on: The word Clinical or the piece ICAL in CLINICAL, inside cross-references like (see CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY). Also weaker on adjectives like competitive or specific before a drug-class noun.

modes.label: Cross-reference to Clinical Pharmacology
modes.description: The word Clinical or ICAL inside a see-section reference in a drug label.

modes.label: Adjective before receptor term
modes.description: An adjective placed before inhibitor or antagonist when describing a drug's action.
